summary: Containment for pipeline regressions on main: post-merge macOS canary holds the drain and files a hotfix task; hotfix lane runs the last canary-green pipeline build (operator choice 2026-10-22, RCA of the Step 10.5 ledger-casing outage)

options.description: Post-merge macOS canary of Steps 10.5-11; red holds the drain and files a pipeline-hotfix task that runs with the last green pipeline sha
Canary plus executors switch to the last canary-green pipeline build while main is red
Executors run the released plugin like adopters; dogfood on HEAD ends
New hard-fail pipeline checks ship warn-only for N tasks

body: Problem: dogfood executors run pipeline-cli at main HEAD, so one merged regression (AISDLC-967, #1848, Step 10.5 ledger path case mismatch) stopped every merge for a day, and the hotfix had to pass through its own bug. Options weighed through the decision rubric with the operator present. Research: Kubernetes/Chromium post-submit canary and revert-on-red; Argo/Spinnaker auto-rollback to last known-good; adopters already run the released plugin. Choice: canary + hotfix lane. Counter-argument: auto-rollback gives zero pause; rebuttal: it needs the canary first and makes executors sign with a pipeline other than main declares; five-step order says automate last, it can follow once the canary has run a month. Released-plugin rejected: loses dogfood on HEAD. Dark-launch rejected: recreates the silent no-op 967 removed. Reversal: drop the canary job and the AI_SDLC_PIPELINE_REF lane. Tasks: AISDLC-1023 (canary + hold + hotfix filing), AISDLC-1024 (hotfix lane).
